01 / The context

A problem worth exploring.

Switching away from a difficult passage interrupts reading. The assistant uses selected text as the context for a focused question.

A native Windows reading assistant that turns highlighted text into explanations, simpler wording, definitions, and key takeaways.

SELECTED PASSAGE · AUTHORED EXAMPLE
Semantic search retrieves documents by comparing embeddings that represent the meaning of a query and its candidate texts.

One passage. Four ways to understand it.

Explain

Semantic search represents a query and documents as numerical vectors. Nearby vectors suggest related meanings, so a saved post can match even when it uses different words.

03 / Decisions & evidence

Behind the experience.

Approach & boundaries

The source implements a WPF sidebar and a provider catalog across three API formats. Selected text, the question, and recent conversation turns are sent to the selected provider. Keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager. The README says OpenAI has received the most testing; other provider paths are less exercised.

C#.NET 8WPFmodel APIs

What the evidence shows

The source code and settings screenshots document the workflow. OCR, visible conversation history, and a UI control for canceling an answer are not implemented in the inspected version.
